behavior: Read-only inspection remains separate from exact saved-transaction confirmation.
Eligible exactResume metadata binds current full transaction hash, signed marker and original versus replacement saved fee ceiling.
Explicit confirmation calls only application.resumeSaved(intentId,{expectedTxHash}); no preparation, fee estimation, proof generation or automatic resend.
Close, reload, account invalidation and unknown send discard RAM eligibility while retaining durable intent.

Long details use internal vertical scrolling; no horizontal clipping.
visual.dialogWidthChecks: both original and replacement confirmations at both sizes; scrollWidth <= clientWidth

Genuine reorg and signed-transaction browser acceptance remain required.
No SDK/wallet bundle rebuilt and no root/shared dependencies changed.
